title: Construct Binary Tree from String
summary: Construct a binary tree from a string that includes integers and parentheses.
statement: Construct a binary tree from a string that includes integers and parentheses. The string represents a binary tree where an integer is the root value, followed by zero, one, or two sets of parentheses indicating child nodes. Always construct the left child first if it exists.
constraints: s contains signed integers and balanced child parentheses.
After a node value, the first group is its left child and the optional second group is its right child; empty () denotes a missing child.
